verdict.rationale: Requesty lets you create service accounts, which are non-human entities with their own keys, and lets each API key or service account carry its own monthly spend cap. That gives an agent a separate, budget-limited credential. However, nothing in the evidence shows permission-level scoping, such as restricting a key to specific models, endpoints or MCP tools, so least-privilege is only partly evidenced. Missing for 10: per-key model/endpoint/tool permission scoping, key expiry/rotation controls, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: Each API key or service account can have its own monthly spend cap.
Service accounts allow you create non-human entities... spend from those keys will not be tied to any user.
